verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run lint to check for linting errors. 2. Run npm run build to verify compilation.

environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No RIOT_API_KEY configured in environment. bun 1.2.14 available. Node 22.23.1 installed via mise.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md warns that Next.js 16 has breaking changes - check node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. Code quality steering requires: zero TypeScript errors, zero lint errors, build must succeed.
key_patterns: API route in app/api/riot/route.ts uses RiotApiError from lib/riot-api.ts. Error handling catches RiotApiError and checks status codes. 401/403 returns user-friendly 503. Missing API key throws with status 500 which falls through to generic handler, leaking internal message.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. lib/ - Shared utilities including riot-api.ts and types. public/ - Static assets.
